verdict.rationale: Antigravity docs describe a dedicated Rules feature where you define standards/conventions with activation modes (Manual, Always On, Model Decision, Glob), and Skills (SKILL.md files) that provide task-specific instructions the agent follows, directly matching the story of a project instructions file for coding standards. Plugins can also bundle rules for reuse across projects. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that rules are reliably honored in practice, and more detail on rules file format/location beyond the brief doc mention.
